title: The goal research story skips the live docs when the pack is good for every committed item
goal: Answers the SP-mlemdqbn retrospective: the goal research story ST-goziyt7i cost 5.6M tokens over 79 turns for about fifty lines, the largest item of the sprint, although kb_pack already answered every fact the items needed and only three side questions were new. kb-sprint plan step 1 and kb/_self/backlog.md Sprints (Plan) say the planner runs the goal's questions through rag.py pack first and narrows the research story's goal to the questions whose coverage is weak or none, naming them; a goal whose every question is good gets a research story whose done needs no outside facts (as ST-idwjvloy proposes).

run: import pathlib,sys;F=(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md","kb/_self/backlog.md");r=[any("research story" in l and "weak or none" in l for l in pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()) for f in F];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)
